caption: The drawing depicts a single brass bell mounted on a gray metallic frame with a curved base. The bell is positioned centrally and is rendered in a shiny golden-yellow color, with highlights indicating reflections on its surface. The clapper inside the bell is red, as is the underside of the bell. The metal frame, which arches around the sides of the bell and supports a pivoting mount, appears gray with some shading to suggest a metallic texture. A handle is attached to the left side of the frame. The background is plain and off-white with no additional objects or decorative elements.
title: Locomotive Bell
